articles.title: Kraken parent Payward to become first crypto firm to buy a EU bank as it expands into deposits, lending
articles.snippet: Payward agreed to buy Lithuania’s Saldo Bank, which holds $190 million in total assets, securing an EU license for deposits and lending.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin falls back to $82,000 after inflation rises more than forecast
articles.snippet: An historic turnaround lower in interest rates suggests the possibility that the bond bear market may have run its course.

articles.title: Solana sets Oct. 21 for Alpenglow upgrade targeting 150-millisecond finality
articles.snippet: The switch will replace Solana’s existing validator voting system, remove vote transactions from blocks and could sharply change headline transaction counts even if user activity stays flat.

articles.title: Kraken parent to buy Lithuanian Saldo Bank amid TradFi expansion
articles.snippet: Payward expects to close the acquisition in 2027, enabling it to expand its traditional banking services into four EU operating markets already served by Saldo Bank.

articles.title: How the SEC’s lack of leadership could facilitate crypto rulemaking
articles.snippet: A recent change in the SEC’s rules on quorum could make it easier for the agency to amend its approach to crypto regulation in the absence of a market structure bill.
